items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: Wendell Eugene. Yeah. Good boy. ... Frog came there after Wendell left. See, Wendell on Tramble on that night.

ctx.x: Were there many other musicians? Probably a few occasionally tell us that they went to that school. I can't remember anybody else in there at the same time you were?

Yeah. Clever Town Hall. That's where I remember you. Clever, you were there. Wendell Eugene. Yeah. Good boy. Seems like a couple other people have told me. A lot of boys. I can't recall that man. It wasn't the one the Sheik was at, was it?
